cameras.flash: Taken at night with the phone's built-in flash: harsh direct flash, a bright hotspot on the nearest part and quick falloff into a darker background, a hard shadow just behind the item, slightly flat colors, visible grain.
cameras.lamp: Taken in the evening under a warm table lamp: a mildly warm white balance that still shows the yarn's true color, high-ISO grain with smeary noise reduction in the shadows, a little soft and a little underexposed.
cameras.overcast: Cool grey daylight from a window on an overcast day: slightly underexposed and bluish, low contrast, soft at the edges of the frame.
cameras.outdoor: Taken outside on an overcast day: flat light, the bright background slightly blown out, a little wind in the fibers, focus a touch off on part of the item.
cameras.oldphone: Looks like it came off an older phone: oversharpened edges, visible JPEG compression, crushed blacks, faint purple fringing on bright edges, the horizon tilted a few degrees.
cameras.snap: A hurried snap: slight motion blur, the frame tilted, the knitter's hand, sleeve or toes caught at the edge of the frame, ordinary clutter partly in view.
cameras.sun: Hard afternoon sun through a window: bright patches and deep shadows across the item, some highlights clipped, a little lens flare haze.
